disorder-name.detail: Schizophrenia; clinical diagnosis confirmed using the Structured Clinical Interview for DSM-5 disorders (SCID); used as the clinical cohort in classification (SZ vs HC) and mass univariate group difference testing benchmarking tasks
disorder-name.supporting_text: "For COBRE and UMich studies, clinical diagnosis of schizophrenia was confirmed using the Structured Clinical Interview used for DSM-5 disorders (SCID)"
disorder-name.location: Rutherford2023.pdf.md: Methods / Demographic, cognition, and clinical diagnosis variables, L92

dataset-of-origin.detail: COBRE (Center for Biomedical Research Excellence) and UMich (University of Michigan SchizGaze study); both datasets contain schizophrenia patients and healthy controls and were used as transfer sets for normative model benchmarking. Combined sample sizes (SZ+HC): COBRE cortical thickness N=124, functional N=121; UMich cortical thickness N=89, functional N=87.
dataset-of-origin.supporting_text: "We leverage several datasets for the benchmarking tasks, the Human Connectome Project Young Adult study (HCP), The Center for Biomedical Research Excellence (COBRE), and the University of Michigan SchizGaze (UMich)"
dataset-of-origin.location: Rutherford2023.pdf.md: Methods / Dataset selection and scanner parameters, L73; Table 1, L77-L82
